provenance.description: Signature, digest, SBOM, licence and publisher.

ApprovalSignal.title: ApprovalSignal

AssistedJourney.description: Declaration of a multi-turn governed assisted onboarding journey.
AssistedJourney.title: AssistedJourney

itemReferenceKind.description: When the collected item is a plain reference id rather than an object (an ENTITY_COLLECTION field submits ids), the declared contract kind it names. Must be a declared kind (Rego). The resolved document supplies each declared key not already carried by the submission itself -- keys read spec.<key>, falling back to metadata.name -- so the emitted item never trusts a client-submitted facet the contract can resolve authoritatively instead.

itemValidations.description: Checks applied to each item, naming a key of the item rather than a field of the payload.

keys.description: The keys each emitted item carries, in the order the document declares them.

optionalKeys.description: Keys carried only when the collected item supplies a non-blank value.

AssistedJourneyCompletionMode.description: Whether a journey emits a governed proposal or only records an observation.
AssistedJourneyCompletionMode.title: AssistedJourneyCompletionMode

AssistedJourneyEmission.description: The declarative replacement for a per-journey emission branch. Everything here is read by one generic renderer: nothing in it names a journey, and nothing outside it decides what a journey emits.

booleanFields.description: Field names whose collected "true"/"false" string is coerced to a real YAML boolean before rendering. The platform compensates here rather than in the renderer: the generic step form has no boolean-aware widget yet (projection-field-options-resolution), so a BOOLEAN_FLAG-shaped value still arrives as free text.

collectionProjections.description: What a multivalued field contributes to the emitted document. A collected item may carry more than the contract needs, so the emitted item is a projection of it -- declared here rather than decided by the renderer, which is what keeps the emitted shape a contract fact.

documentTemplateRef.description: The DocumentTemplate that renders the document. Must resolve to a declared template rendering the same kind (Rego). Absent while a journey emits a document this vocabulary cannot yet describe -- the renderer refuses such an emission rather than guessing, and the journey keeps a named branch until a template can replace it, which is exactly what the boundary allowlist records.

fieldConditions.description: Fields the emitted document carries only under a declared condition. A template drops a key whose lone placeholder resolves to nothing, so a conditional key needs no template conditional of its own -- the condition removes the value and the existing absence rule removes the key. Applied after fieldDefaults, so a default never resurrects a field the condition has removed.

fieldDefaults.description: Values used when a field was not collected, so a template needs no conditional of its own.

pathTemplate.description: Where the document is written, with ${id} standing for the resolved identifier, e.g. `.jumo/teams/${id}.yml`.

referenceChecks.description: Checks that a collected value names a contract that exists, so a journey never proposes a document pointing at nothing.

routingEligibilityCheck.description: Refuses a proposal that would route work to a team the project did not declare eligible. A project with no declared eligibility constrains nothing, as RoutingEligibility itself is additive.

targetKind.description: The contract kind the emitted document declares. Must name a declared kind (Rego).

validations.description: Field-level checks the collected payload must pass before anything is written.

AssistedJourneyEmission.title: AssistedJourneyEmission

AssistedJourneyEmissionBundleItem.description: One ordered document of an atomic same-repository bundle. emission reuses AssistedJourneyEmission unchanged; fanOutCollection and condition are the only bundle-specific additions.

condition.description: Skips this item, and its whole fan-out when declared, unless met.

fanOutCollection.description: The collected multivalued field this item emits one document per item of. Identifiers, paths, validations and template values resolve in the current item's scope. Absent means the item emits at most once.

AssistedJourneyEmissionBundleItem.title: AssistedJourneyEmissionBundleItem

AssistedJourneyEmissionCondition.description: An equality condition deciding whether a bundle item is emitted at all, checked before any fan-out over its collection.

equalsValue.description: The bundle item is emitted when whenField equals this value, and skipped otherwise.

whenField.description: The collected or derived value this bundle item's presence depends on.

AssistedJourneyEmissionCondition.title: AssistedJourneyEmissionCondition

AssistedJourneyEmittedIdentifier.description: How the emitted document's identifier is derived from the run, always by slugifying one collected field rather than by a rule the platform keeps per journey.

defaultValue.description: Used when the field was not collected.

AssistedJourneyEmittedIdentifier.title: AssistedJourneyEmittedIdentifier

AssistedJourneyFieldCondition.description: One field of the emitted document and the collected value that decides whether it is present at all.

equalsValue.description: `field` is kept when `whenField` equals this value, and removed otherwise.

whenField.description: The collected or derived value the presence of `field` depends on.

AssistedJourneyFieldCondition.title: AssistedJourneyFieldCondition

value.description: May itself interpolate ${id} or another collected field.

AssistedJourneyIdentifierSuffix.description: What is appended to a slugified identifier so two runs of the same journey do not collide.
AssistedJourneyIdentifierSuffix.title: AssistedJourneyIdentifierSuffix

AssistedJourneyNavigationMode.description: Whether the role may choose any dependency-ready step or must follow declaration order.
AssistedJourneyNavigationMode.title: AssistedJourneyNavigationMode

itemPath.description: For a multivalued field, the key inside each item that carries the reference.

kind.description: The contract kind the value must name. Must be a declared kind (Rego).

i18nKey.description: Resolved the same way a ProjectionField's own i18nKey is, so a step rendered by ProjectionRenderer and the same step recapped after completion show the identical label.

emission.description: What a PROPOSAL journey emits when its run completes: the contract kind, where it is written, the template that renders it, and the checks the collected fields must pass. Rego requires it of every PROPOSAL journey (canonical decision 15) -- without it the platform would have to recognise the journey by name to know what it produces, which is the dispatch this slot exists to remove. A journey declares emission or emissionBundle, never both (Rego).

emissionBundle.description: The atomic same-repository alternative to emission: an ordered list of documents one run writes together, each reusing AssistedJourneyEmission unchanged and optionally fanning out over a collected collection field or gated by an equality condition. Runtime path resolution and atomic intake are a later lot; this vocabulary only.

emitsCapability.description: The single capability a proposal journey may invoke. Observation journeys leave this absent.

navigationMode.description: FREE permits navigation among dependency-ready steps; dependencies remain mandatory server-side.

policySetRefs.description: PolicySet contracts that govern every admission to this journey. The runtime refuses the journey unless each reference is active on the addressed RealmTemplate.

presentation.description: Default presentation for this journey and every step, overridable per step by AssistedJourneyStep.presentationOverride.

requiredCapabilities.description: Complete capability allowlist for this journey. The runtime journey authorization entrypoint checks every admitted action against it; ProjectionSpec.actions and emitsCapability must be subsets (Rego).

resourceBudgetRef.description: Names the ResourceBudget whose modelCalls limit bounds the clarification-turn ceiling (AC1). The journey does not declare its own ceiling.

summaryI18nKey.description: Prefix JourneySummaryStep.vue resolves three keys from at its completion step: `${summaryI18nKey}Title`, `${summaryI18nKey}ConfirmLabel` and `${summaryI18nKey}SuccessMessage`. Lets one generic completion component describe what this journey actually produced instead of fixed onboarding text.

AssistedJourneyStep.description: stepKind/projectionRef/processRef are additive: the model-driven rendering engine that consumes them does not exist yet, so requiredFields stays required and load-bearing -- JourneyService (control-plane) reads it server-side and apps/web/components/journey/JourneyRunner.vue reads it client-side. requiredFields is retired once every AssistedJourney step declares projectionRef/processRef and the renderer that replaces JourneyRunner.vue exists; until then both describe the same steps.

dependsOn.description: Step IDs that must be completed before this step becomes available.

descriptionI18nKey.description: i18n key resolving this step's user-facing description. When present, takes precedence over the literal description string, which remains the fallback for journeys that have not been translated.

image.description: Step-level hero image, overriding the journey's heroImage for this step only. Falls back to AssistedJourneySpec.heroImage when absent. Not validated by the schema (same convention as heroImage) -- a kit-distributed asset once JumoKit exports binary assets (portability.yaml).

narrationI18nKey.description: i18n key resolving this step's personaNarration ("Nestor's voice"). Same fallback convention as descriptionI18nKey.

parallelizable.description: Marks a dependency-ready step as part of a parallelizable work group in the renderer.

presentationOverride.description: Per-field override of the journey's presentation for this step only. An absent field falls back to AssistedJourneySpec.presentation.

processSpecRef.description: The ProcessSpec whose run an AWAIT step observes. Required on AWAIT once stepKind is set (Rego).

projectionSpecRef.description: The ProjectionSpec this step renders. Its `of:` class is the step payload type, so the shape is derived rather than declared twice. Required on COLLECT and CONFIRM once stepKind is set (Rego).

promptTemplateRef.description: The PromptTemplate this step uses when stepKind is DIALOGUE_COLLECT.

requiredFields.description: One entry per field the step collects or confirms, each carrying the i18n key journey-generic-step and the completed-step recap render for it. A bare field-name string list let two journeys reusing the same field name for a different meaning (e.g. purpose) collide on one hardcoded label; this does not.

requiredObligations.description: Additional obligations the caller must satisfy before this step is entered, submitted, selected or invoked. Evaluated with the journey envelope by the single kind-level runtime rule under policy/authz; an empty list is explicit and still fail-closed.

stepKind.description: Required from the model-driven renderer onward (Rego).

subAssistedJourneyRef.description: The AssistedJourney this step delegates to when stepKind is SUB_JOURNEY.

verificationSpecRef.description: Generic real observation required before this step can advance.

AssistedJourneyStep.title: AssistedJourneyStep

AssistedJourneyStepKind.description: The IHM-layer counterpart to ProcessStepKind (execution.yaml): AssistedJourney is a human-facing collection graph, while ProcessSpec remains the durable execution graph.
AssistedJourneyStepKind.title: AssistedJourneyStepKind

AttentionInterruptibility.description: Ordered least to most intrusive. Separate from urgency on purpose: a critical item can still belong in the morning digest, and conflating the two is how everything urgent becomes an interruption.
AttentionInterruptibility.title: AttentionInterruptibility

AttentionItem.description: The human-facing routing projection of something that wants a person. It is PostgreSQL recognized state (canonical decision 21), never a Git proposal or effect authority.
AttentionItem.title: AttentionItem

classification.description: Same enumeration as capability data access, retrieval and rendering (canonical decision 98).

confidence.description: Confidence of the interpretation behind this item, not of the outcome it reports.

roleId.description: The individual acting role this came from, never a team (ADR-0017). Absent on ADMISSION_REFUSED.

AttentionType.description: Closed rather than open: an unenumerated type is one a digest cannot route and a policy cannot match. ADMISSION_REFUSED carries work Jumo will not take on, so it has no role to come from.
AttentionType.title: AttentionType

AutonomyLevel.description: Progressive autonomy ladder. Configured per action class, channel, audience, risk and Realm -- never as one global agent level.
AutonomyLevel.title: AutonomyLevel

BranchProtectionState.description: ADVISORY means the Forge does not prevent a direct push, a force-push or a self-approved merge. A declaration is not a control -- it is a claim the owner makes.
BranchProtectionState.title: BranchProtectionState

BudgetOnExhaustion.description: DEGRADE_ASSURANCE is deliberately absent: reducing assurance requires an explicit policy decision, not a budget default.
BudgetOnExhaustion.title: BudgetOnExhaustion

CapabilityProfile.description: A human-facing named preset over a WorkerRequirementProfile vector. Names an intent, never a model or a power score (ADR-0019, ADR-0082).
CapabilityProfile.title: CapabilityProfile

presenceRef.description: Optional ThemePack terminology key. Decoration only.

workerRequirementProfileRef.description: The WorkerRequirementProfile this preset resolves to.

ChangeProposalRef.description: Narrow hash-bound reference; it never contains a document body or secret.
ChangeProposalRef.title: ChangeProposalRef

ChangeSetFile.description: One ordered file within a ChangeSetProposal. Path traversal and duplicate paths within a proposal are rejected by ChangeSetProposalService, not by this shape.
ChangeSetFile.title: ChangeSetFile

ChangeSetProjection.description: Observed record of the single atomic PR ForgeApplier opened for a ChangeSetProposal (multi-repository-change-set-saga AC2/AC5). ChangeSetProjection.title: ChangeSetProjection

ChangeSetProposal.description: Ordered multi-file changeset proposed against one repository, the unit ForgeApplier opens as one repository PR within a multi-repository saga (multi-repository-change-set-saga AC1). Owner approval and phase progression are tracked separately, not on this shape.
ChangeSetProposal.title: ChangeSetProposal

ChiefOfStaffProfile.description: Configures a Chief-of-Staff role's attention loop and work disposition. Selects a responsible role and interaction timing; grants no authority.
ChiefOfStaffProfile.title: ChiefOfStaffProfile

directWorkProcessSpecRef.description: Governed child Episode started by HANDLE_DIRECTLY; cannot be the intake workflow itself (Rego). References a ProcessSpec (execution.yaml).

enabled.description: Source schema pins this to `const: true`; enforced in Rego, not expressible as a LinkML boolean constant.

CliAdapterProfile.description: Adapter execution profile and command template for a CLI worker runtime.
CliAdapterProfile.title: CliAdapterProfile

CliInstallationDesiredState.description: Desired CLI installation state on a specific machine.
CliInstallationDesiredState.title: CliInstallationDesiredState

CliInstallationObservation.description: Observed installation and doctor health status of a CLI tool on a machine.
CliInstallationObservation.title: CliInstallationObservation

CliInvocationEvent.description: Streaming event produced during an active CLI invocation.
CliInvocationEvent.title: CliInvocationEvent

CliInvocationRequest.description: Structured WorkOrder execution invocation dispatched to a CLI worker container.
CliInvocationRequest.title: CliInvocationRequest

CliInvocationResult.description: Sanitized final output payload, exit code, and evidence digest from a CLI execution.
CliInvocationResult.title: CliInvocationResult

CliRelease.description: Durable Git contract pinning an immutable OCI container release for a CLI tool.
CliRelease.title: CliRelease

CliToolDefinition.description: Durable Git contract declaring an AI CLI tool available for execution.
CliToolDefinition.title: CliToolDefinition

CliUsageObservation.description: Observed consumption metrics from CLI tool invocations.
CliUsageObservation.title: CliUsageObservation

ComplianceMapping.description: Example mappings are marked DRAFT; no MAPPED or EVIDENCED status may be displayed as a certification claim (enforced in Rego, not here).

controlRef.description: References a Control.controlId in the linked ControlCatalog.

referentialArticle.description: e.g. an AI Act article number, an ISO clause number.

ComplianceMapping.title: ComplianceMapping

ComplianceProfile.description: A named referential (edition, official URI) and its mappings to a ControlCatalog (docs/concepts/positionnement-conceptuel.md#conformite-et-auditabilite-par-construction). Split out of GovernanceOverlay. Never recopies referential text -- identifiers, edition, and URI only. Carries the RGPD art. 30 processing register: a compliance profile scoped to data protection references the processing activities it covers, rather than inventing a separate kind for a register most Realms will attach to exactly one profile.
ComplianceProfile.title: ComplianceProfile

controlCatalogRef.description: The ControlCatalog this profile maps against.

edition.description: e.g. "2023", "2022" -- the referential's published edition, never its text.

officialUri.description: Stable URI to the official referential. No copyrighted text is stored here.

processingRegister.description: RGPD art. 30 register of processing activities this profile covers. Empty for non-privacy referentials.

ComplianceStatus.description: MAPPED or EVIDENCED is never a certification claim by itself. Only EXTERNALLY_ATTESTED, backed by an EvidenceProfile with independent attestation, may be shown as one.
ComplianceStatus.title: ComplianceStatus

ConnectorActivationDecision.description: Owner approval and activation decision activating a connector package.
ConnectorActivationDecision.title: ConnectorActivationDecision

ConnectorAppraisal.description: The reviewed judgement that lets an McpBundle leave DECLARED. Findings live here because they are a decision; the runs behind them stay recognized state and are cited by evidenceRefs. An appraisal grants no authority: it unlocks a lifecycle transition.
ConnectorAppraisal.title: ConnectorAppraisal

appraisedDigest.description: The exact artifact that was looked at. When the bundle digest moves, this appraisal stops being accepted, so an upstream version bump cannot inherit the prior review.

mcpBundleRef.description: The McpBundle this appraises. Refused across Realms (Rego).

upstreamInventory.description: Every tool the upstream server offered when it was looked at, exposed or not -- enumerating what was held back is the point of the whole document.

verifiedByRoleDefinitionRef.description: The role that checked it, which is not the one that performed it.

ConnectorCredentialRequirement.description: Declared credential requirements and delivery mode for a connector.
ConnectorCredentialRequirement.title: ConnectorCredentialRequirement

ConnectorDefinition.description: A Realm-owned catalog entry for an external system boundary. MCP is one transport among several. Discovery is observational; only operations mapped to declared capabilities can be requested.
ConnectorDefinition.title: ConnectorDefinition

ConnectorIntegration.description: Durable Git contract grouping related connectors (e.g. Google Workspace) into a coherent UX unit.
ConnectorIntegration.title: ConnectorIntegration

ConnectorPackage.description: Platform-only Git contract manifest defining a complete connector package under .jumo/connector-packages/<id>/. Publication in the Platform corpus is a technical-reuse fact and confers no Realm consent, secret or activation authority (ADR-0050 decision 8).
ConnectorPackage.title: ConnectorPackage

ConnectorPackageCertification.description: Platform-only technical certification of an exact ConnectorPackage build. Records CI-verified digests only (ADR-0050 decision 8); carries no Realm consent, activation or secret-authority field. Distinct from the Realm-scoped ConnectorAppraisal, which records human dual-consent appraisal.
ConnectorPackageCertification.title: ConnectorPackageCertification

supportedTransportDigests.description: One digest per McpServerDescriptor in the certified package's supportedTransports, each sha256: followed by the SHA-256 of that descriptor's canonical JSON -- object keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace, absent fields omitted. Certifying a transport the package does not declare, or omitting one it does, is refused by corpus.certification.transport-consistency. Computed by scripts/generate/compute-package-digests.py.

packageDigest.description: SHA-256 of the package's content manifest. The manifest lists one line per content file, "<sha256 hex>  <path relative to the package directory>", sorted by path, newline terminated; packageDigest is sha256: followed by the SHA-256 of those bytes. Content files are exactly sourcePaths when declared, otherwise every file in the package directory except this manifest, which carries the digest and so cannot hash itself. Computed and checked by scripts/generate/compute-package-digests.py.

supportedTransports.description: The MCP transports this package exposes. A ConnectorPackageCertification attests to exactly this set through supportedTransportDigests, one digest per descriptor.

ConnectorSessionBinding.description: Active OAuth or API session binding for a Principal/Realm and target machine.
ConnectorSessionBinding.title: ConnectorSessionBinding

ConnectorTestCase.description: A single test case in a connector verification plan.
ConnectorTestCase.title: ConnectorTestCase

ConnectorTestPlan.description: Deterministic test plan for verifying connector operations on a target machine.
ConnectorTestPlan.title: ConnectorTestPlan

ConnectorTestResult.description: Observed result and evidence of a connector test case execution.
ConnectorTestResult.title: ConnectorTestResult

ConsumptionReport.description: What the work spent, in units ResourceBudget declares. Keys held identical to ResourceBudget.spec.limits by scripts/validate-integration-contracts.py today; Rego takes over that cross-check.
ConsumptionReport.title: ConsumptionReport

ContractReference.description: Structured reference to a Git-declared contract document.
ContractReference.title: ContractReference

ControlAssessment.description: Recognized result of assessing a Control against a ComplianceProfile, with observed evidence. Runtime-only (PostgreSQL), not a Git contract kind -- no apiVersion/kind wrapper. No CERTIFIED or CONFORMANT status without external attestation, evaluator identity, and a validity period (enforced in Rego).
ControlAssessment.title: ControlAssessment

ControlCatalog.description: Internal controls, reusable across ComplianceProfiles (docs/concepts/positionnement-conceptuel.md#conformite-et-auditabilite-par-construction). Split out of the source GovernanceOverlay's inline `controls[]` array, so a control is declared once and mapped from many profiles rather than copy-pasted per referential.
ControlCatalog.title: ControlCatalog

ConversationTask.description: The closed set of ConversationService turn kinds. Declared on the PromptTemplate that serves it, so the platform resolves task -> prompt from the contract instead of naming the PromptTemplate id in a switch.
ConversationTask.title: ConversationTask

CoordinationMechanismBinding.description: One coordination mechanism scoped to the dependency it actually governs, replacing a single team-wide mode (docs/concepts/positionnement-conceptuel.md#coordination-des-dependances). Shared by TeamSpec and CoordinationProfile so a team's inline coordination and a reusable named profile speak the same vocabulary.

dependencyKind.description: Open vocabulary naming the managed dependency (e.g. resource-sharing, prerequisite, simultaneity, decomposition -- Malone & Crowston's categories). Not an enum: the catalog of dependency kinds is expected to grow with experience, and closing it here would recreate the single-mode rigidity this redesign removes.

phase.description: Open vocabulary naming the work phase this binding applies to.

riskTier.description: Open vocabulary; aligns with ActionCapabilitySet's riskTier where relevant.

CoordinationMechanismBinding.title: CoordinationMechanismBinding

CoordinationProfile.description: A named, reusable coordination profile: authorized mechanisms, target dependencies, rhythm, and preconditions for team coordination. Distinct from TeamSpec.coordination (inline, per-team) -- a CoordinationProfile is declared once and referenced by name from multiple teams or improvement-loop targets, while TeamSpec.coordination is that team's own binding. Already used mechanisms[] in the source schema (unlike TeamSpec's single `mode`), so this class's mechanisms list was not itself the redesign target -- it gains the same CoordinationMechanismBinding shape as TeamSpec for vocabulary consistency, replacing what was a flat CoordinationMechanism list.
CoordinationProfile.title: CoordinationProfile

CredentialHeaderStyle.description: How a ProviderAccount's activated credential is carried on an outbound request through provider-egress. Matches RequestShape's per-protocol header choice one for one.
CredentialHeaderStyle.title: CredentialHeaderStyle

DataScope.description: Widest audience a document or capability's data may be served to. Kept as one enum for audience/publication checks: see InformationClassification and the classification/compartment/release-transformation split below for the narrower declassification-transformation concept. DataScope itself is not retired, since dozens of existing schemas key off it for a single publication-boundary check, and splitting it everywhere at once would be overreach for that one check.
DataScope.title: DataScope

DelegatedSecretGrant.description: One response-wrapped OpenBao child token grant issued for a lease and SecretBinding pair (openbao-delegated-lease). Never carries the token or accessor value itself -- only an envelope-encrypted accessor ciphertext and its digest, for restart-safe revocation and audit.
DelegatedSecretGrant.title: DelegatedSecretGrant

DeliveryMode.description: How a result or an AttentionItem reaches the human. Shared by Practice and AttentionItem so a rhythm and the items it carries cannot describe delivery in two vocabularies. Pausing delivery never deletes the canonical event.
DeliveryMode.title: DeliveryMode

DispositionMatch.description: minProperties:1 in the source (at least one match field present) moves to Rego.

addressedRoleRefs.description: RoleDefinitions this rule matches as the addressee.

addressedTeamRefs.description: TeamSpecs this rule matches as the addressee.

DispositionMatch.title: DispositionMatch

DocumentFrontMatter.description: Metadata every governed Markdown document declares, so a retriever can carry a passage's authority and audience along with its text. An ungoverned RAG loses both at chunk time: explanatory prose comes back looking like a rule, and a Realm-private paragraph comes back to whoever asked. Those are the documentary forms of privilege escalation, and this schema is where they are refused (ADR-0014).

answers.description: Questions this document answers, in the words a person would use.

audience.description: Widest scope a retrieval may serve this document to. Required with no default, because a default here would silently publish.

decisions.description: Canonical decision numbers (docs/00-canonical-decisions.md) this ADR backs.

enforced_by.description: Comma-separated paths that mechanically enforce this document's rules. Checked for existence by scripts/check-corpus-budget.py.

lang.description: ISO 639-1 code of the document's prose. Defaults to English; a non-normative document may declare fr for explanatory text (docs/concepts/positionnement-conceptuel.md).

normative.description: Whether this document states rules. Travels with every chunk: a retriever may quote a false document as explanation and never as authority (ADR-0005 applied to retrieval).

DocumentFrontMatter.title: DocumentFrontMatter

DocumentTemplate.description: A YAML document with ${placeholder} scalars, rendered into the contract a journey proposes. The body is one string rather than a typed nesting because the shape it renders is the shape of whichever kind the journey emits -- the same reason a step payload with no generated class declares payloadSchemaRef against a raw JSON Schema (projection.yaml). Substitution happens after the body is parsed, so a placeholder standing alone as a value may be filled by a list or a mapping, not only by a scalar.
DocumentTemplate.title: DocumentTemplate

body.description: The YAML document, with ${placeholder} where a collected or derived value goes.

renders.description: The contract kind this template produces, checked against the emission that names it (Rego).

maximumAudience.description: Widest audience any document under this root may claim. A ceiling, not a default: a directory set to REALM_PRIVATE holds for everything in it regardless of what a single file declares.

path.description: Repository-relative directory. No leading slash and no '..'.

Effect.description: Policy outcome. Only policies authorize; principles never do (ADR-0005).
Effect.title: Effect

EffectRecoveryKind.description: Replaces the source schemas' `reversible: boolean`: compensation is application-specific and can itself fail, so a single boolean does not say which of these applies (docs/concepts/positionnement-conceptuel.md#sagas-et-recuperation).
EffectRecoveryKind.title: EffectRecoveryKind

EffectTestAuthorization.description: Dual-consent authorization record for executing irreversible effect tests.
EffectTestAuthorization.title: EffectTestAuthorization

rung.description: Matches a WorkerRequirementProfile.spec.quality.reasoningEffort value one for one; the resolver picks the account's rung with the same name instead of a per-profile alias.

EngagementMethod.description: A reusable, Git-governed method for a Realm-scoped Matter. Describes work; grants neither authority nor employment status.
EngagementMethod.title: EngagementMethod

EvidenceProfile.description: The type, source, freshness, independence, and retention an assessment's evidence must meet. Split out of GovernanceOverlay. Carries the DPIA (RGPD art. 35) alongside the pre-existing evidence-quality fields -- an impact assessment is itself a form of evidence about the system, not a separate concept.
EvidenceProfile.title: EvidenceProfile

claimCoverage.description: What claim this evidence class actually supports: provenance volume alone is not proof (docs/concepts/positionnement-conceptuel.md#preuve-et-assurance).

defeaters.description: Known conditions that would invalidate this evidence class.

dpia.description: RGPD art. 35 impact assessment, when this evidence profile concerns personal data processing.

retention.description: How long this evidence must be kept, explicit rather than left implicit.

EvidenceRecord.description: Append-only sanitized execution observation linked to one WorkerInvocation.
EvidenceRecord.title: EvidenceRecord

ExecutionCell.description: A Realm-bound execution cell boundary that manages compute placement, local credential custody, and outbound mTLS execution leases.
ExecutionCell.title: ExecutionCell

ExecutionCellCredentialCustody.description: Where an ExecutionCell's mTLS client key lives after the certificate ceremony. LOCAL_CELL_SEALED is the only custody corpus.cell.credential-custody (execution.rego) permits; JUMO_STORED names the real, deliberately-refused alternative (the control plane holding the guest's private key), so the enum stays a genuine choice and the Rego rule stays the authority rather than the schema silently making it unreachable.
ExecutionCellCredentialCustody.title: ExecutionCellCredentialCustody

ExecutionCellLease.description: Ephemeral sandbox execution lease bound to a machine, WorkOrder, SHA, and contract digest.
ExecutionCellLease.title: ExecutionCellLease

ExecutionCellProvisioningRef.description: Narrow hash-bound reference to one hosted-execution-cell provisioning run. Same narrow shape as ProcessRunRef/ForgeProjectionRef: it never contains VM identifiers, key material, or pairing-code proof -- those stay in ExecutionCell and its pairing ledger.
ExecutionCellProvisioningRef.title: ExecutionCellProvisioningRef

mountedPersonalSpaceRefs.description: PersonalSpace documents mounted into this cell's private workspace filesystem. Each referenced PersonalSpace must belong to the same Realm as this cell (Rego, corpus.cell.workspace-realm-scoped) -- private documents never mount into another tenant's dedicated Execution Cell.

ExecutionMachine.description: Durable Git contract defining an execution machine bound to a single Realm.
ExecutionMachine.title: ExecutionMachine

ansibleBaselineRef.description: No confirmed Git-contract target kind exists for this field yet (ADR-0045 migration audit, contract-reference-migration-execution AC1) -- left as an opaque scalar pending an owner decision on what a machine's Ansible baseline should resolve to.

FederatedPeer.description: Desired bilateral Jumo peer configuration. Unavailable until recognized pairing evidence confirms both sides.
FederatedPeer.title: FederatedPeer

FederationProfile.description: A negotiated, namespaced protocol profile. Describes messages only and cannot grant authority.
FederationProfile.title: FederationProfile

FieldRepresentation.description: Semantic shape of one field's value, never a component name. A front-end component registry is the only place this resolves to a concrete widget. STRUCTURED_YAML also names a WritePathEditor value (interface.yaml): same underlying shape, two different concerns -- there a write-target file format, here a field's read/edit representation -- so the shared name is deliberate, not an oversight.
FieldRepresentation.title: FieldRepresentation

ForbiddenSolicitationReach.description: Delegation is never transitive. A grant to A does not let A pass it to B.
ForbiddenSolicitationReach.title: ForbiddenSolicitationReach

ForgeProvider.description: GitHub is the only implemented Forge in V0, behind a Forge-neutral abstraction (canonical decision 55).
ForgeProvider.title: ForgeProvider

HttpMethod.description: HTTP request methods for API operations.
HttpMethod.title: HttpMethod

ImportedSchemaCandidate.description: Candidate LinkML class proposal derived from an external MCP tool schema.
ImportedSchemaCandidate.title: ImportedSchemaCandidate

ImprovementDirection.description: Required so the loop's effect on corpus size is visible per recommendation. CONSOLIDATE and DELETE exist because an additions-only loop is the failure mode check-corpus-budget.py bounds.
ImprovementDirection.title: ImprovementDirection

ImprovementLoop.description: How a Project learns from its own finished work. Declares what is measured, which rhythm synthesizes the measurements, which corpus paths a recommendation may name, and how many may be open at once.
ImprovementLoop.title: ImprovementLoop

projectRef.description: One loop never reaches across Projects; that would be a delegation, not a rhythm.

ImprovementMeasure.description: Closed, and every entry computable without a model from material that already exists: protocol fields, WorkOrder state, budgets, front matter and recognized state.
ImprovementMeasure.title: ImprovementMeasure

ImprovementRecommendation.description: One actionable finding against a Project's corpus, in Git. Carries no authority of its own; reaches the corpus through the same proposal capabilities as any other change. Reclassified as runtime-only, alongside WorkOrder and AttentionItem, once a runtime store exists to demote into.
ImprovementRecommendation.title: ImprovementRecommendation

pathGlob.description: Path-traversal exclusion (`not: pattern ..\/`) moves to Rego.

IndependentVerificationState.description: ADVISORY means no automated check confirms a WorkOrder's producer and verifier are distinct actors in this realm. A declaration is not a control -- it is a claim the owner makes, and ENFORCED costs an observation and a reference to it, same as BranchProtectionState.
IndependentVerificationState.title: IndependentVerificationState

InformationClassification.description: Confidentiality dimension, split out from the single DataScope enum: classification, ownership, and declassification are distinct concerns (docs/concepts/positionnement-conceptuel.md#flux-dinformation). Used where an explicit cross-Realm release transformation is modeled, alongside ReleaseTransformation and ReleaseCompartment below -- not a replacement for DataScope's simpler publication-boundary role.
InformationClassification.title: InformationClassification

InteroperabilityAdapter.description: Sealed registry of authorized public interoperability adapters.
InteroperabilityAdapter.title: InteroperabilityAdapter

InvocationAuthorizationReceipt.description: Signed, single-use MCP invocation authorization (ADR-0055). Bound to exactly one invocation id, lease, Realm, operation, argument digest and tools digest; carries no session or renewal field and therefore cannot represent renewable session authority. A lease gateway without this receipt cannot contact the upstream.
InvocationAuthorizationReceipt.title: InvocationAuthorizationReceipt

JourneyPresentation.description: Decorative and layout-only: how a journey or step is drawn, never what it may do. Carries no capability, no policy, no budget and no workflow field, on the same terms as ThemePack. Declared on the journey and overridable per step; an absent field at step level falls back to the journey's.

maxWidth.description: Maximum content width in pixels for the surface. Absent means no constraint.

stepperLayout.description: Whether the step list renders as a vertical rail or a horizontal slide group.

subJourneyOpenMode.description: How a SUB_JOURNEY step opens its child run; meaningless on any other stepKind.

surfaceMode.description: Whether the journey or step mounts as a page, a modal dialog, or inline within its host container.

JourneyPresentation.title: JourneyPresentation

JourneySurfaceMode.description: How a journey or step mounts in the cockpit shell.
JourneySurfaceMode.title: JourneySurfaceMode

JourneyVerificationSpec.description: Secret-free declaration of an explicit real observation a journey step may request.

capability.description: Must resolve in an ActionCapabilitySet (Rego), the same way ProcessStep.capabilityRef is checked.

JourneyVerificationSpec.title: JourneyVerificationSpec

JumoKit.description: Root manifest for one portable Jumo Kit repository. Official schemas are supplied by Jumo, never by the kit repository. An active contract kind: the manifest a kit repository itself declares.
JumoKit.title: JumoKit

assetExports.description: Optional binary assets (images) and i18n bundles (json) the kit distributes, distinct from `exports` because these are opaque content, not corpus-governed YAML documents -- no LinkML class validates their bytes, only their provenance (KitLockSpec.renderedAssets digest). Images and i18n bundles share this one tree rather than splitting into two export lists: both are inert content a journey (AssistedJourneyStep.image/heroImage) or the frontend i18n loader references by rendered path, never executed.

bindings.description: Open string-keyed map in the source schema, modeled as a list of key/type pairs (see ThemePack for the same pattern).

KitBinding.description: Realm-local, closed binding for one Jumo Kit release. Supplies values but never grants authority.
KitBinding.title: KitBinding

KitBindingValue.description: Open string-keyed map (string|number|boolean values) in the source schema, modeled as key/value pairs; value kept as string, the widest common representation.
KitBindingValue.title: KitBindingValue

KitLock.description: Rendered provenance for one admitted Jumo Kit. Records bytes and evidence; does not authorize execution.
KitLock.title: KitLock

renderedAssets.description: Provenance for assetExports (JumoKitSpec) admitted by this release, if any.

KitReleaseCertification.description: Portable independent review of an exact Jumo Kit release and its executable modules or connector artifacts. signedBy != verifiedBy (source schema's $data cross-field check) moves to Rego -- no actor certifies its own release.
KitReleaseCertification.title: KitReleaseCertification

LayerOverride.description: Explicit declaration of an overridden document from a lower layer or imported kit.
LayerOverride.title: LayerOverride

MachineAdminCommand.description: Ansible playbook execution command sent to an enrolled machine.

playbookRef.description: The playbook's physical execution path (MachineAdminPlaybookSpec.playbookPath), not a second contract reference -- the control plane resolves the MachineAdminRequest's ContractReference to a MachineAdminPlaybook once and forwards the resolved path so the machine-agent has a direct, unambiguous execution instruction rather than needing corpus access itself. ADR-0045 decision 4 treats physical paths as non-contractual scalars.

MachineAdminCommand.title: MachineAdminCommand

MachineAdminPlaybook.description: Git-governed allowlisted Ansible playbook definition for machine administration.
MachineAdminPlaybook.title: MachineAdminPlaybook

MachineAdminPlaybookSpec.description: Specification of an allowlisted machine admin playbook.

appliesToCapability.description: The capability this playbook implements. The platform resolves which playbook to dispatch by scanning for the one declaring the capability a ProcessStep names (capabilityRef), instead of naming the playbook instance by id -- a sealed capability name is platform vocabulary, never an instance identifier (canonical decision 15). At most one playbook may claim a given capability (Rego).

MachineAdminPlaybookSpec.title: MachineAdminPlaybookSpec

MachineAdminRequest.description: Web administration request to dispatch an allowlisted Ansible playbook to a machine.
MachineAdminRequest.title: MachineAdminRequest

MachineAdminResult.description: Result and sanitized evidence of an Ansible admin command execution.
MachineAdminResult.title: MachineAdminResult

MachineEnrollmentChallenge.description: Short-lived enrollment challenge issued by the control plane.
MachineEnrollmentChallenge.title: MachineEnrollmentChallenge

MachineEnrollmentRequest.description: BYOVM one-shot machine enrollment request carrying CSR and system inventory.
MachineEnrollmentRequest.title: MachineEnrollmentRequest

MachineEnrollmentResult.description: Result of a machine enrollment challenge containing issued mTLS certificates.
MachineEnrollmentResult.title: MachineEnrollmentResult

MachineHealthObservation.description: Observed real-time health and load status of an execution machine.
MachineHealthObservation.title: MachineHealthObservation

MachineHostDefinition.description: Durable Git contract defining the host environment and driver for a machine.
MachineHostDefinition.title: MachineHostDefinition

MachineInventoryObservation.description: Observed hardware and OS characteristics of an enrolled machine.
MachineInventoryObservation.title: MachineInventoryObservation

MachineRuntimeInstallation.description: Observed runtime installation (CLI or connector) on a target machine.

runtimeRef.description: Polymorphic on the sibling `kind` field (CLI or connector) -- resolves to a CliToolDefinition or a ConnectorDefinition depending on it.

MachineRuntimeInstallation.title: MachineRuntimeInstallation

McpBundle.description: A reviewed, deployable MCP package. Describes mechanism and semantic affordances; never grants authority.
McpBundle.title: McpBundle

agentGuidance.description: When to reach for this operation and when not to, written for the choosing agent.

killSwitchRef.description: Required in Rego when effect is SYSTEM_EFFECT and the bundle is ENABLED (ADR-0056 decision 4).

recoveryPlanDigest.description: Required in Rego when effect is SYSTEM_EFFECT and the bundle is ENABLED (ADR-0056 decision 3).

untrustedOutput.description: Whether this operation returns content originating outside the trust boundary.

upstreamToolName.description: The raw MCP tool this semantic operation wraps. Never leaves this document -- there is no generic connector.invoke (ADR-0019, decision 161).

McpBundleRuntime.description: An McpBundle's single upstream branch is always OCI_STDIO with a pinned artifact (McpBundleSpec.artifact); the STREAMABLE_HTTP branch has no bundle and is reached only through ConnectorDefinitionSpec.remoteMcpServiceRef and RemoteMcpServiceSpec.transport MCP_STREAMABLE_HTTP (ADR-0050 decisions 6-7).

placement.description: v2 admits only EXECUTION_CELL; CLIENT_CELL and REMOTE remain declarable at the schema level but are refused by corpus.bundle.execution-cell-only-placement (Rego, not schema) for the same reason.

upstreamKind.description: Not schema-required -- the pinned jumo-core sibling source only gains this field at its own pace; enforced unconditionally in Rego instead (corpus.bundle.upstream-kind-required), which reads the live composed corpus rather than a stale lock.

McpBundleRuntime.title: McpBundleRuntime

McpCatalogProvenancePin.description: Immutable source observation pin carried into generated connector material; it is evidence, never authority.
McpCatalogProvenancePin.title: McpCatalogProvenancePin

McpCatalogServer.description: Recognized PostgreSQL projection of sourced catalog observations. Catalog state never grants a Realm capability.
McpCatalogServer.title: McpCatalogServer

McpInventorySnapshot.description: PostgreSQL event recording an MCP inventory discovered under an exact Realm lease; it is not a Git contract.
McpInventorySnapshot.title: McpInventorySnapshot

McpInvocationAuthorizationReceipt.description: Signed, short-lived authorization receipt bound to exactly one MCP invocation.
McpInvocationAuthorizationReceipt.title: McpInvocationAuthorizationReceipt

McpInvocationAuthorizationRequest.description: Machine-authenticated request to authorize one planned MCP operation without persisting arguments.
McpInvocationAuthorizationRequest.title: McpInvocationAuthorizationRequest

McpInvocationDispatchRequest.description: Machine acknowledgement that a signed MCP invocation receipt is about to dispatch upstream.
McpInvocationDispatchRequest.title: McpInvocationDispatchRequest

McpInvocationOutcome.description: Sanitized terminal outcome for one dispatched MCP invocation.
McpInvocationOutcome.title: McpInvocationOutcome

McpProtocolProfile.description: Supported MCP protocol capabilities and versions.
McpProtocolProfile.title: McpProtocolProfile

McpRegistrySource.description: Platform-scoped configuration for a bounded registry adapter. It authorizes neither installation nor execution.
McpRegistrySource.title: McpRegistrySource

McpRegistrySourceBinding.description: Realm-owned declaration binding a Platform McpRegistrySource to the ExecutionMachine and lifecycle authorized to sync it. Carries WorkOrder/operator attribution for the binding decision and grants no installation, execution or credential authority.
McpRegistrySourceBinding.title: McpRegistrySourceBinding

lifecycle.description: Platform-declared default lifecycle. A Realm's McpRegistrySourceBinding.lifecycle is the live, Realm-scoped selection and may differ.

workOrderRef.description: No longer required (decision AC1) -- attribution for a new binding belongs on McpRegistrySourceBinding.

McpServerDescriptor.description: Descriptor specifying MCP server transport and connection target.
McpServerDescriptor.title: McpServerDescriptor

McpToolDescriptor.description: Tool schema and metadata captured during MCP discovery.
McpToolDescriptor.title: McpToolDescriptor

Metadata.description: Shared identity block for every contract document.
Metadata.title: Metadata

order.description: Delivery order. Breaks ties when two milestones would otherwise sort ambiguously; the generated roadmap groups in this order, not declaration order.

NestedOptionsSource.description: Resolves a field's options from a nested multivalued attribute of one specific document, for a value object with no standalone Git contract of its own -- Project.spec.milestones is the motivating case. optionsFrom resolves one option per whole document of a declared kind; this resolves one option per entry of a list nested inside a single document instead.

labelPath.description: Dotted path, relative to each nested entry, used as the option's display title. Defaults to the entry's own `id` when absent.

path.description: Dotted path to the nested multivalued attribute within the resolved document's own spec, e.g. `spec.milestones`.

sourceId.description: The metadata.id of the one document of sourceKind to read. A literal address, not resolved from another field on this same document -- proportionate while exactly one instance of sourceKind is ever declared (true of Project today); broaden to cross-field addressing only if that stops holding.

sourceKind.description: The declared ContractKind holding the nested list. Must name a declared kind (Rego), the same check optionsFrom uses.

NestedOptionsSource.title: NestedOptionsSource

OAuthClientBinding.description: Durable Git contract binding an OAuth client registration to a Realm.
OAuthClientBinding.title: OAuthClientBinding

OfferingSpec.description: Hypothesis-level managed-service offer for a client-owned Solo deployment. Records the commercial assumption separately from the durable control-plane decisions that will survive or outlive the experiment. Renamed from ManagedServiceOffer: the vehicle for offering packaging. Numeric const values in the source schema (fixed prices, fixed durations) are kept as plain typed fields with an ifabsent default carrying the source's pinned value, rather than encoded as JSON-Schema-style constants LinkML has no direct equivalent for -- several of these are expected to become genuinely configurable, so a plain field is the more honest fidelity choice here.
OfferingSpec.title: OfferingSpec

OperationEffect.description: SYSTEM_EFFECT is the recovery-gated root system-effect branch (ADR-0056); an ENABLED bundle operation with this effect requires recoveryPlanDigest and killSwitchRef -- enforced in Rego, not schema.
OperationEffect.title: OperationEffect

Organization.description: A tenant boundary with its own Git contract source. Unlike OrganizationSpec, which models an operational composition of roles, this contract names an Organization that composes policy for its member Realms without creating inter-Realm access or effect authority.
Organization.title: Organization

OrganizationAccessBinding.description: Explicit Git binding for Organization owners, administrators, and auditors. MEMBER is intentionally derived by OrganizationEnrollmentPolicy rather than written as an ambient role.
OrganizationAccessBinding.title: OrganizationAccessBinding

OrganizationAuditRetentionPolicy.description: Default retention for terminal recognized-state history in one Organization.
OrganizationAuditRetentionPolicy.title: OrganizationAuditRetentionPolicy

contractRepository.description: Git repository URL or deployment-supplied reference for this Organization's .jumo source.

realmProvisionerProjectionSpecRef.description: Approved bounded provisioner for self-enrolled Realm creation; never a federation authority.

OrganizationEnrollmentPolicy.description: Approved OIDC admission rule for derived MEMBER status and a bounded onboarding provisioner. It neither creates mTLS federation nor gives a member authority in another Realm.
OrganizationEnrollmentPolicy.title: OrganizationEnrollmentPolicy

OrganizationEnrollmentRequest.description: First, identity-admitted onboarding payload. The trusted provisioner consumes the bounded request only after policy approval; this payload itself neither creates a Realm nor a Git repository.
OrganizationEnrollmentRequest.title: OrganizationEnrollmentRequest

OrganizationPublicationPolicy.description: Organization-level publication policy setting allowed interoperability adapters, public JWKS, and publication quota.
OrganizationPublicationPolicy.title: OrganizationPublicationPolicy

OrganizationRetentionHold.description: A time-bounded, auditable Organization-wide pause of terminal-history purge.
OrganizationRetentionHold.title: OrganizationRetentionHold

OrganizationRole.description: Governance role in an Organization tenant. It is deliberately distinct from a RoleDefinition: organization membership coordinates contracts and audit only and never grants a Realm's data, secret, execution-cell, or effect authority.
OrganizationRole.title: OrganizationRole

humanSeat.description: True for the human-owner seat, which is never filled by an AgentDefinition bearer.

roleDefinitionRef.description: The RoleDefinition this seat is bound to.

seatId.description: A named seat in this organization, e.g. "chief-of-staff", "implementer", "reviewer", "owner".

OrganizationSpec.description: A named organization of roles for a recurring mission (docs/concepts/positionnement-conceptuel.md#organisation-moise), referencing RoleDefinition, TeamSpec, RoleAssignment, and OrganizationTemplate without replacing or absorbing any of them -- those classes stay independently declarable, which is what "renamed without absorption" means at the composite-class boundary too. The software-delivery example: a chief-of-staff role, an implementer, a reviewer, a human owner, plus incompatibility and independence constraints between them.
OrganizationSpec.title: OrganizationSpec

incompatibleSeatPairs.description: Seats that may never be filled by the same RoleAssignment bearer (e.g. implementer and reviewer). Enforced in Rego, not here.

independentSeatGroups.description: Seats whose bearers must sit in different independence groups (e.g. reviewer needs a distinct provider group from implementer). Enforced in Rego.

organizationTemplateRef.description: Optional OrganizationTemplate this organization was instantiated from.

roleRefs.description: References RoleDefinition entries this organization uses, each bound to a named seat.

OrganizationTemplate.description: Parametric package of roles, teams, profiles, and lifecycle. Contains no grant. Renamed from OrganizationBlueprint -- the name OrganizationSpec is reserved for the composite class in work.yaml.
OrganizationTemplate.title: OrganizationTemplate

PersonalSpace.description: Mandatory personal space declaration for a human or agent principal within a Realm.
PersonalSpace.title: PersonalSpace

ownerPrincipal.description: Principal (user or agent) owning this personal space.

ownerRealm.description: Realm this personal space belongs to. An ExecutionCell may only mount a PersonalSpace whose ownerRealm matches its own (Rego, corpus.cell.workspace-realm-scoped).

PlannedOperation.description: One operation exposed by a signed MCP gateway session plan, resolved from a validated InvocationCapabilityGrant (mcp-gateway-session-plan-signing AC2). Mirrors dev.jumo.mcpgateway.plan.PlannedOperation on the gateway side.
PlannedOperation.title: PlannedOperation

PolicyInput.description: Typed input structure evaluated by OPA policies.
PolicyInput.title: PolicyInput

PolicyRule.description: Conditional requiredness (ALLOW_WITH_OBLIGATIONS / REQUIRE_APPROVAL require obligations) moves to Rego.

reasonCode.description: Sanitized code safe to expose across a Realm boundary (canonical decision 66).

when.description: Named structural condition evaluated by the policy engine. Free text is not permitted at evaluation time.

PolicyRule.title: PolicyRule

PolicySet.description: Executable authorization. Only policies allow, deny or impose obligations. Every action named here must resolve against the capability registry.
PolicySet.title: PolicySet

scope.description: A lower scope may restrict but never silently expand a higher one (canonical decision 65).

Practice.description: A recurring governed invocation. Rather than owning its own cron/timezone/invokes fields, a Practice references a ProcessSpec (execution.yaml) whose START step is kind: TIMER -- the schedule lives once, on the process, not twice (once here and once conceptually on whatever the source schema's separate WorkflowDeclaration would have needed). This removes the source schema's `schedule` and `invokes` blocks entirely; `delivery`, `autonomy`, `budgetRef`, and `enabled` are unchanged.
Practice.title: Practice

delivery.description: How the result reaches the human. Always LIVE is an interruption schedule, not a rhythm.

processSpecRef.description: Exact metadata id of the retained TIMER-triggered ProcessSpec release this Practice invokes. A Practice never follows a mutable logical process pointer.

Preferences.description: User or agent preferences attached to a PersonalSpace.
Preferences.title: Preferences

PresenceDensity.description: How much is shown at once. CALM is the default posture -- Jumo is measured on attention it returns.
PresenceDensity.title: PresenceDensity

Principal.description: A person the Realm knows about: its owner, a Realm member with a personal space, or an external contact with no login. A Principal grants no authority -- Membership, capability grants and policy remain required for anything it does (ADR-0080).
Principal.title: Principal

PrincipalIdentityBinding.description: Explicit Realm-local binding between a member or owner Principal and its OIDC subject. It grants no authority and is never prompt context.
PrincipalIdentityBinding.title: PrincipalIdentityBinding

consentState.description: NOT_APPLICABLE for OWNER and MEMBER, who consented by joining the Realm. For a CONTACT, the Realm's own record of whether that person agreed to being modeled -- never proof of consent, only a claim the Realm makes.

personalSpaceRef.description: Present only for OWNER and MEMBER. A CONTACT has no login or workspace here.

principalKind.description: OWNER and MEMBER may hold a PersonalSpace and bear RoleDefinitions; a CONTACT is modeled by someone else's Realm and has neither.

inspiresPolicies.description: A principle may inspire a policy, but the policy must be explicit and reviewable (canonical decision 16). Documentation link, not an authorization path.

PrincipleSet.description: Judgement heuristics. Principles influence prioritization, communication and judgement; they never grant capabilities (ADR-0005). The authority field is constrained to INFLUENCE_ONLY so this cannot drift.
PrincipleSet.title: PrincipleSet

authority.description: Structurally enforced. A PrincipleSet cannot declare any other authority.

branchLabel.description: Required when `from` names a GATEWAY step with more than one outgoing flow (Rego).

from.description: A ProcessStep id in this same ProcessSpec.

payloadType.description: A generated LinkML class name; every edge carries an explicit typed payload.

to.description: A ProcessStep id in this same ProcessSpec.

ProcessSpec.description: A durable process: a graph of typed steps and flows, compiled to a Temporal Workflow and projected to BPMN 2.0 XML for audit and rendering. A Temporal Workflow normally corresponds to an Episode (canonical decision 39, unchanged by this redesign).
ProcessSpec.title: ProcessSpec

stageWorkerRequirementRef.description: Task requirements per model-using step (source schema's open string-keyed map, modeled as key/value pairs -- see ThemePack for the same pattern). Every key must name a declared step and every value resolves to a WorkerRequirementProfile (Rego).

steps.description: Must include exactly one START and at least one END (Rego).

timerDelay.description: Required only for TIMER starts; ISO-8601 duration rather than cron.

ProcessStep.description: One node in the process graph. inputType/outputType/capabilityRef/opaEntrypoint are used selectively by kind: a GATEWAY step names opaEntrypoint (the OPA decision that selects its outgoing flow); a SERVICE step names capabilityRef and inputType/outputType; a TIMER START step carries the schedule fields Practice.processSpecRef (work.yaml) points at. Which fields apply to which kind is a Rego invariant, not encoded structurally here -- LinkML has no tagged-union/discriminated-class construct clean enough to justify one ProcessStep subclass per kind for what is otherwise one shape.

capabilityRef.description: Required on a SERVICE step (Rego); must resolve in an ActionCapabilitySet.

idempotencyKey.description: Required on a SERVICE step whose capability producesExternalEffect (Rego).

opaEntrypoint.description: Required on a GATEWAY step (Rego): the Rego rule the ProcessSpec compiler wires as the decision selecting this gateway's outgoing branch.

ring.description: Must not exceed the ringCeiling of capabilityRef's ActionCapability (Rego).

semanticStage.description: The WorkflowDeclaration-era stage this step corresponds to, where applicable.

signalType.description: Required on USER and MESSAGE signals; resolves to a generated LinkML class.

subprocessReleaseRef.description: The exact ProcessSpec release this SUBPROCESS step invokes (Rego required-on-SUBPROCESS check in execution.rego; must resolve, see references.rego).

terminalState.description: Required on END and forbidden elsewhere.

ProcessStep.title: ProcessStep

ProcessStepKind.description: The BPMN-shaped element kinds the ProcessSpec compiler maps to Temporal and, separately, projects to BPMN 2.0 XML via an element-mapping table.
ProcessStepKind.title: ProcessStepKind

ProcessStepSemanticStage.description: Verbatim from WorkflowDeclaration.spec.stages (source schema). Ordering invariants previously enforced by scripts/validate-contracts.py ("policy evaluation and capability acquisition must precede effect application"; "OUTCOME_ASSESSMENT follows OUTCOME_MEASUREMENT and never stands alone"; "neither assessment nor synthesis may share a workflow with EFFECT_APPLICATION") move to Rego using graph.reachable_paths over this ProcessSpec's steps/flows.
ProcessStepSemanticStage.title: ProcessStepSemanticStage

dpiaEvidenceProfileRef.description: References an EvidenceProfile carrying the DPIA (art. 35), when required.

ProhibitedAuthority.description: Explicit denials that no policy may override.
ProhibitedAuthority.title: ProhibitedAuthority

Project.description: A governed body of work declared in a Realm control repository. Git repositories are optional bound resources, not the identity of a Project.
Project.title: Project

canonicalDecisions.description: Folded in from the retired ProjectContract kind (owner decision O3, 2026-08-22).

authority.description: No component may treat its local representation as authority for another category (ADR-0002).

documentation.description: Where this Project's governed Markdown lives and who may retrieve it. Jumo indexes declared roots and nothing else (ADR-0014).

milestones.description: Declared in delivery order. Groups the generated roadmap and bounds every WorkOrder's roadmapRef (Rego corpus.work.roadmap-ref-declared).

ownerRealm.description: A Project has exactly one canonical owner Realm (ADR-0004).

purpose.description: Folded in from the retired ProjectContract kind (owner decision O3, 2026-08-22).

repositoryBindings.description: Zero or more Git resources governed by this Project. A repository-free Project remains valid.

optionsEligibility.description: Conditions every instance of `optionsFrom` must satisfy to be offered. The eligibility a selection applies is part of what the contract says the field means, so it is declared here rather than left to whichever surface happens to render the field. Conditions read the candidate's Git document only -- desired and contractual state; recognized runtime state (a machine's observed health) is a different authority and is not reachable from a projection.

optionsFrom.description: A contract kind whose declared instances populate this field's options, replacing a hardcoded roster lookup with a projection over real Git contracts. Must name a declared kind (Rego). An instance is offered as its `metadata.id` labelled by its `metadata.name`; a projection selects which instances are offered, never how one is addressed. Mutually exclusive with optionsFromEnum and optionsFromNested (Rego).

optionsFromEnum.description: A generated LinkML enumeration whose permissible values populate this field's options, for a field whose domain is a closed vocabulary rather than a contract kind. Mutually exclusive with optionsFrom and optionsFromNested (Rego). Rego checks that an ENUMERATION field declares one of the three, not that this names an enumeration rather than a class: the repository facts carry per-class slots, not permissible values, so the narrower check waits on a fact this module does not produce.

optionsFromNested.description: An alternative to optionsFrom for a value object with no standalone Git contract of its own, such as Project.spec.milestones -- see NestedOptionsSource. Mutually exclusive with optionsFrom and optionsFromEnum (Rego).

path.description: A slot of the ProjectionSpecBody.of class this field projects (Rego).

required.description: When an AssistedJourneyStep declares both projectionRef and requiredFields (work.yaml), requiredFields must name exactly the fields marked required here (Rego) -- the two lists describe the same gate and must not be allowed to drift.

ProjectionOptionCondition.description: One condition a candidate instance must satisfy to be offered as a field's option.

equalsValue.description: The value at `path` must equal this string. Exactly one of equalsValue and present is required (Rego).

path.description: A dotted path into the candidate contract document, e.g. `spec.desiredState`.

present.description: The value at `path` must be present and non-empty. Exactly one of equalsValue and present is required (Rego).

ProjectionOptionCondition.title: ProjectionOptionCondition

ProjectionSpec.description: A named view of one generated LinkML class. `of:` follows the same "generated LinkML class name" pattern as ProcessFlow.payloadType and ProcessStep.signalType (execution.yaml) rather than introducing a second typed-payload vocabulary.
ProjectionSpec.title: ProjectionSpec

actions.description: Every named action must resolve against a declared ActionCapability (Rego, same check as every other capability reference in this metamodel) and must also be among `renderedBy`'s surface's `proposes` list (Rego) -- a projection can never claim an action its rendering surface does not offer.

of.description: A generated LinkML class name (metamodel/generated/manifest.json), the same pattern ProcessFlow.payloadType and ProcessStep.signalType use. Must name a declared class (Rego). Mutually exclusive with payloadSchemaRef; exactly one of the two is required (Rego) -- a payload either has a generated class or it does not, never both.

payloadSchemaRef.description: A JSON Schema 2020-12 document declared under a corpus schemas directory (e.g. jumo-core:.jumo/schemas), for a step payload with no generated LinkML class of its own -- the metamodel names no such instance-specific class (canonical decision 15). Must resolve to a declared schema file (Rego). Mutually exclusive with of.

renderedBy.description: The id of an InterfaceSurface `Surface` this projection is scoped to. Required and checked against every declared surface (Rego), rather than optional, so a projection nobody lists is never silently unconstrained -- the same fail-closed shape as every other reference in this metamodel.

sections.description: Rendered fields grouped into sections. May be empty only for an action-only projection, where actions is non-empty and the projection exists solely to anchor a headless journey step's callable capabilities (Rego).

path.description: Optional path to the body, for prompts too long to inline.

javaType.description: Fully qualified target type for STRUCTURED output.

targetKind.description: For a STRUCTURED output whose javaType is a reusable generic proposal shape (for example SelectionIntentProposal), the contract kind every proposed ref must name -- e.g. ConnectorDefinition. The same role AssistedJourneyEmission.targetKind already plays -- one class serving every domain that needs the shape instead of one class per target kind (canonical decision 15); absent when javaType is not generic over a target kind.

PromptTemplate.description: A prompt is Ring 2 material: reviewable, versioned agent behavior (ADR-0008). Belongs to exactly one AgentDefinition; the capabilities its output may propose are constrained to a subset of what that definition requests.
PromptTemplate.title: PromptTemplate

conversationTask.description: The ConversationService task this prompt serves. Optional -- most PromptTemplate documents are referenced by a journey step, not by a conversation task, and leave this unset.

mayProposeCapabilities.description: Enforced as a subset of the owning AgentDefinition's requestedCapabilities (Rego). Proposing is still not granting: policy decides.

ProviderAccount.description: One model or CLI account and the window its quota renews in. ResourceBudget bounds a single Episode; this bounds the account across Episodes (ADR-0013).
ProviderAccount.title: ProviderAccount

independenceGroup.description: Accounts sharing a group are not independent. Falling back within the same group would let one account both produce and verify (docs/concepts/positionnement-conceptuel.md#diversite-des-pannes) -- a declared separation, not a proof of independence; a fault-diversity vector (provider, model, prompt, sources, tools, framing) would be the finer-grained signal, not yet modeled as its own field. Inherited from the referenced ProviderPlatform's independenceGroup when absent.

provider.description: Vendor and access path, such as anthropic-cli or openai-api. Two accounts on the same vendor are not independent of each other.

secretBindingRef.description: The sole OpenBao binding that may hold this named account's credential; the value is never contractual state.

ProviderNativeEffort.description: Provider-native reasoning-effort parameters, applied verbatim by RequestShape for the rung's protocol -- OpenAI reasoning_effort, Anthropic thinking budget and max_tokens, Google thinkingConfig.

reasoningEffort.description: Provider-native effort token passed through verbatim (e.g. OpenAI's 'medium' or 'high').

thinkingBudgetTokens.description: Native thinking-token budget for a protocol that exposes one (Anthropic extended thinking, Google thinkingConfig).

ProviderNativeEffort.title: ProviderNativeEffort

ProviderPlatform.description: The declared catalog entry a ProviderAccount is opened against -- wire protocol, upstream host, credential header style, egress route, and the default effort ladder new accounts inherit. Adding an aggregator or OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a contract change against this catalog and a provider-egress regeneration, never a value typed directly into a ProviderAccount (ADR-0002 -- the worker cannot select a host).
ProviderPlatform.title: ProviderPlatform

defaultEffortLadder.description: The rung-by-rung ladder every account opened against this platform inherits unless it declares its own ProviderRouting.effortLadder.

egressRouteId.description: Names the generated provider-egress nginx location this platform's traffic proxies through. Never a raw URL; the worker builds only /{egressRouteId}/... and cannot select an upstream itself.

hostDeclaredByAccount.description: True only for a generic platform (e.g. an OpenAI-compatible aggregator such as OpenRouter) whose upstream host is named per-account instead of fixed by this catalog entry.

independenceGroup.description: Default independenceGroup for an account opened against this platform when the account does not declare its own.

upstreamHost.description: Fixed TLS upstream for an integrated platform. Forbidden when hostDeclaredByAccount is true (Rego); a generic platform's host is named per-account instead.

ProviderQuotaObservation.description: Observed quota and rate limit status from an upstream provider.
ProviderQuotaObservation.title: ProviderQuotaObservation

duration.description: Required when kind is ROLLING or CALENDAR; forbidden when METERED (Rego).

effortLadder.description: Overrides the platform's defaultEffortLadder rung for rung when declared. Absent by default, so a newly declared account inherits the platform's ladder and is routable immediately -- the fix for the N-times-M dead account problem a per-account requirementAliases list produced.

gatewayRef.description: Required when mode is GATEWAY_ROUTED; forbidden when PLAN_DIRECT (Rego).

platformRef.description: The ProviderPlatform catalog entry this account was opened against. Required when mode is GATEWAY_ROUTED; forbidden when PLAN_DIRECT, which has no upstream provider-egress traffic (Rego).

priority.description: Deterministic account selection order for a compatible worker requirement profile. Lower values are selected first.

upstreamHost.description: Required exactly when the referenced ProviderPlatform declares hostDeclaredByAccount true (a generic platform such as an OpenAI-compatible aggregator); forbidden otherwise (Rego).

ProviderSessionBinding.description: Recognized opaque binding between a holder provider session and one ExecutionMachine. It never contains a bearer token, refresh token, or provider credential.
ProviderSessionBinding.title: ProviderSessionBinding

RealmEnforcement.description: ENFORCED requiring observedAt/evidenceRef/evidenceMaxAge moves to Rego: claiming enforcement costs an observation and a reference to it.

evidenceMaxAge.description: Maximum age of the Forge protection observation before an autonomy gate must treat the claim as stale (ADR-0028, default PT24H).

independentVerification.description: Optional, additive claim distinct from branchProtection. Not wired into whether the corpus.independence.* rules apply -- those keep running unconditionally regardless of this field. Only claiming ENFORCED here has any effect: it must then carry its own fresh independentVerificationObservedAt/independentVerificationEvidenceRef within independentVerificationEvidenceMaxAge (Rego), same evidence-costs-a-claim shape as branchProtection.

independentVerificationEvidenceMaxAge.description: Maximum age of the independent-verification observation before its ENFORCED claim must be treated as stale, default PT24H.

RealmEnforcement.title: RealmEnforcement

RealmExposureMode.description: Exposure and federation posture of the Realm. Defaults to PRIVATE_STEALTH. PRIVATE_STEALTH isolates the Realm from unauthenticated external discovery and intra-cluster visibility. CLUSTER_SHARED allows peer discovery and role sharing within the same hosted cluster. PUBLIC_DISCOVERABLE exposes public agent cards and external federation endpoints.
RealmExposureMode.title: RealmExposureMode

RealmIngressBinding.description: Per-tenant DNS routing for one RealmTemplate. `baseDomain` is deliberately not named `canonicalDomain` or `hostname`: OfferingTopology.canonicalDomain and OfferingTopology.hostname (this same module) already use both names for an inclusion flag, not a domain value -- a third reuse of either name for a different shape would recreate the exact collision the `ProjectionSource`/`ProjectionSpec` naming warns against elsewhere in this metamodel. Deliberately carries no audience, policy, capability or other authority-bearing attribute: Rego refusing two RealmTemplates the same hostname protects routing correctness, not authorization -- that stays on RealmEnforcement.

baseDomain.description: The parent domain subdomain is bound under, e.g. jumo.dev or a client-owned domain.

subdomain.description: DNS label distinguishing this Realm's hostname under baseDomain.

RealmIngressBinding.title: RealmIngressBinding

RealmPublication.description: Governed public interoperability exposition under /u/{handle} for a Realm. Narrowed to the Organization publication policy envelope.
RealmPublication.title: RealmPublication

RealmSphere.description: Organizational grouping only. A sphere never constitutes a security boundary.
RealmSphere.title: RealmSphere

RealmTemplate.description: A Realm is a governance, privacy and security boundary. Spheres group work inside a Realm without being security boundaries (canonical decision 12). `ingress` is the same shape one level up, for DNS instead of workspace grouping: `RealmIngressBinding` carries no audience, policy, capability or other authority-bearing attribute, so a subdomain stays routing only by construction, never a security boundary -- `enforcement` on this same spec remains the only field that is.
RealmTemplate.title: RealmTemplate

contractRepository.description: Target git repository URL or forge path for this Realm.

exposure.description: Realm exposure posture. Defaults to PRIVATE_STEALTH (fail-closed, invisible by default).

ingress.description: Optional per-tenant subdomain routing. Absent for a Realm with no hosted hostname of its own, the same "field-free stays valid" shape as Project.repositoryBindings.

kitBindingRefs.description: Ordered list of kit bindings determining precedence.

owner.description: The canonical owner Principal. A literal TODO is rejected (Rego).

policySetRefs.description: Relative paths to PolicySet documents. Resolved and existence-checked (Rego).

principleSetRefs.description: Relative paths to PrincipleSet documents. Influence only.

ReleaseCompartment.description: The audience/purpose compartment a declassified value is released into.
ReleaseCompartment.title: ReleaseCompartment

ReleaseTransformation.description: How a value crossed from its classification into its compartment.
ReleaseTransformation.title: ReleaseTransformation

RemoteMcpService.description: A Realm-local remote MCP endpoint. URLs and OAuth material are references resolved only in the Realm Cell.
RemoteMcpService.title: RemoteMcpService

RenderedKitAsset.description: Provenance for one rendered binary asset or i18n bundle -- same digest-provenance shape as RenderedKitFile, kept a separate class because the source/target patterns admit assetExports' file types instead of `.yml`.
RenderedKitAsset.title: RenderedKitAsset

approvalPolicy.description: OWNER_ONLY (default): only the ownerRealm may authorize forge writes. MUTUAL_CONSENT: every co-owner Realm must signal approval before ForgeApplier merges.

coOwnerRealms.description: Additional Realm identifiers that co-govern this repository. When non-empty, all named Realms must declare a matching RepositoryBinding pointing at the same repository. Policy enforces mutual binding via Rego (corpus.project.mutual-repo-binding).

repository.description: owner/name. A literal TODO is rejected (Rego, for the placeholder scan).

ResourceBudget.description: Per-Episode frugality limits. Assurance may never degrade silently to stay within budget.
ResourceBudget.title: ResourceBudget
