minimumAssurance.description: A floor. Exhaustion may never push the Episode below it without explicit policy and approval.

ResponseSufficiency.description: A worker's own structured signal about whether its answer, as given, is sufficient (worker-sufficiency-bounded-escalation AC1). Reported only when the declaring WorkerRequirementProfile's interaction.structuredOutput is REQUIRED.
ResponseSufficiency.title: ResponseSufficiency

Ring.description: Self-modification ring (ADR-0008). Ring 0 is never an ordinary change target.
Ring.title: Ring

RiskTier.description: ROOT capabilities are Ring 0 and are never grantable through an ordinary workflow.
RiskTier.title: RiskTier

RoleAssignment.description: Git-declared bearer of one stable role. Selects responsibility and provenance only; Membership, policy and grants remain required for every act. Renamed from OperatorAssignment.
RoleAssignment.title: RoleAssignment

RoleBearer.description: Discriminated union (HUMAN | AGENT | FEDERATED_PEER) in the source schema. LinkML has no native discriminated union at the attribute level; modeled as one class with branch fields optional. Which fields are required for which `kind` moves to Rego, same disposition as every other conditional-requiredness invariant here.

defaultWorkerRequirementProfileRef.description: Optional, only meaningful when kind is AGENT.

federatedPeerRef.description: Required when kind is FEDERATED_PEER. Names the FederatedPeer contract.

remoteRoleKey.description: Optional remote role identifier in the peer realm.

RoleBearer.title: RoleBearer

RoleDefinition.description: A stable Realm-owned acting role carrying a mission. Its bearer is declared separately by RoleAssignment; neither declaration grants authority. Renamed from Operator.
RoleDefinition.title: RoleDefinition

delegatedRealmRef.description: Optional child or target Realm governed by this meta-role.

independenceGroup.description: A role's own separation-of-duties group. Two roles sharing one group may not jointly produce and verify the same WorkOrder (governance.rego distinct_independence_groups); absent for a meta-role (Nestor, Owner) that is never itself a team roster candidate.

isMetaRole.description: When true, this role acts on behalf of a Jumo Control Plane or Child Realm.

roleKey.description: Optional decorative ThemePack lookup key. Never replaces metadata.id.

RoleLifecyclePolicy.description: Onboarding policy and evaluation criteria for roles. Renamed from OperatorLifecyclePolicy -- kept as its own class, not absorbed into RoleDefinition.
RoleLifecyclePolicy.title: RoleLifecyclePolicy

RoutingDecision.description: Immutable policy-authorized adapter and cell selection for one recognized turn.
RoutingDecision.title: RoutingDecision

RoutingEligibility.description: A desired routing eligibility relation between roles or teams and a Project. Teams flatten to their role leaves. Never grants data access, capabilities or effect authority. Renamed from OperatorBinding.
RoutingEligibility.title: RoutingEligibility

SchemaBinding.description: Deterministic link between a payload, its LinkML class, and exact schema digest.
SchemaBinding.title: SchemaBinding

SchemaBoundPayload.description: Bounded dynamic JSON payload guaranteed by a validated SchemaBinding.
SchemaBoundPayload.title: SchemaBoundPayload

SecretBinding.description: A Git-declared reference to runtime secret material. Values are deliberately not representable here.
SecretBinding.title: SecretBinding

SecretBindingSpec.description: anyOf(allowedBundleRefs, allowedRemoteServiceRefs, allowedConnectorRefs, allowedWorkerSubstrateRefs) moves to Rego.

allowedWorkOrderRefs.description: WorkOrders authorized to request a delegated lease grant of this binding. Reciprocity with WorkOrderSpec.secretBindingRefs is required by policy (openbao-delegated-lease AC2).

runtimeRef.description: Account- or connector-scoped OpenBao KV-v2 reference resolved by the per-Realm SecretBroker; not a secret value.

SecretBindingSpec.title: SecretBindingSpec

SelectionIntentProposal.description: Structured output of a DIALOGUE_COLLECT step capturing what the assistant proposes selecting, from a declared catalog, in response to the user's stated intent (AssistedJourneyStep.promptRef, PromptOutput form: STRUCTURED; PromptOutput.targetKind names the ContractReference kind every selectedRefs entry must be, e.g. ConnectorDefinition). A proposal, never a grant or a configuration: selectedRefs must be drawn only from the realm's declared catalog of that kind, supplied as the prompt's RAG context (the same corpus ContractLoader loads for CapabilityGatewayService), never invented by the model. The user still confirms selection explicitly; this class only bounds what the model may say back. One declaration reused across every domain that needs this shape, instead of one class per target kind (canonical decision 15).

openQuestion.description: A clarifying question to continue the dialogue when intent is still ambiguous. Absent once the proposal is considered final for this turn.

rationale.description: One entry per selectedRefs, explaining the match to the stated intent.

selectedRefs.description: Ids proposed, of the kind PromptOutput.targetKind names, referencing the supplied catalog only.

SelectionIntentProposal.title: SelectionIntentProposal

SelfDescription.description: How a Project or agent explains itself. Extraction is deterministic and reads only .jumo/ and recognized state; narration merely phrases facts already extracted. A model never retrieves here, so an explanation cannot invent a commitment the contracts do not contain.
SelfDescription.title: SelfDescription

narrationPromptTemplateRef.description: Optional PromptTemplate that phrases the extracted facts.

from.description: Deterministic source: a contract kind and path such as 'Project.spec.purpose', or a named recognized-state query. Evaluated without a model.

SelfDescriptionQuestion.description: Fixed vocabulary so every governed Project answers the same questions, and Nestor can federate the answers without bespoke integration per Project.
SelfDescriptionQuestion.title: SelfDescriptionQuestion

SessionPlan.description: Signed MCP gateway session plan scoped to one ExecutionCellLease (mcp-gateway-session-plan-signing AC2) -- carries the planSignature envelope dev.jumo.mcpgateway.plan.SessionPlan's javadoc names but does not yet have a field for.

upstreamToolsDigest.description: Digest of the complete discovered tool inventory of the one upstream connector accepted for this plan, using mcp-tools-jcs-v1. Signed with the plan so a gateway can refuse a later upstream inventory change before dispatch.

SessionPlan.title: SessionPlan

SessionPlanRequest.description: Request to issue a signed MCP gateway session plan for one ExecutionCellLease (mcp-gateway-session-plan-signing AC2).
SessionPlanRequest.title: SessionPlanRequest

SharedRepositoryApprovalPolicy.description: Who must approve a forge-write against a shared repository binding. OWNER_ONLY applies when a single Realm owns the binding. MUTUAL_CONSENT blocks merge until all co-owner Realms have acknowledged.
SharedRepositoryApprovalPolicy.title: SharedRepositoryApprovalPolicy

SolicitationContract.description: The only way one Project or Realm may solicit another (canonical decision 25). Exposes a typed interface, never internal Project data. Renamed from DelegationContract: the word "delegation" is reserved for authority delegation, explicitly excluded from V1, and this schema never modeled that -- it models a typed cross-Project request contract.
SolicitationContract.title: SolicitationContract

SubJourneyOpenMode.description: How a SUB_JOURNEY step opens its child run. Meaningless on any other stepKind.
SubJourneyOpenMode.title: SubJourneyOpenMode

SufficiencyEscalationPolicy.description: A profile's disposition on an INSUFFICIENT_NEEDS_DEPTH signal (ADR-0019). NONE is the default: no automatic retry, the existing human-decision path applies. AUTO_BOUNDED retries the same invocation once at the next effort rung, never above the ladder's own ceiling and only while the declared ResourceBudget still has model-call budget for it -- otherwise it falls back to the same human-decision path as NONE.
SufficiencyEscalationPolicy.title: SufficiencyEscalationPolicy

Surface.description: Conditional (reads containing FORGE_PROJECTIONS forces audience REALM_PRIVATE) moves to Rego.
Surface.title: Surface

SurfaceWritePath.description: Path traversal, editor-to-path compatibility, and required-obligation preservation are semantic constraints enforced by Rego.
SurfaceWritePath.title: SurfaceWritePath

leadRoleDefinitionRef.description: Required when any mechanism binding uses DIRECT_SUPERVISION; must resolve to a role leaf of this team. Conditional requiredness moves to Rego.

TeamMember.description: Discriminated union (roleMember | teamMember) in the source schema. Modeled as one class; exactly one of roleDefinitionRef/teamSpecRef is expected (Rego).
TeamMember.title: TeamMember

TeamSpec.description: A Realm-owned composition of roles and nested teams. Coordinates eligible roles but grants no data access, capability or effect authority. Renamed from OperatorTeam.
TeamSpec.title: TeamSpec

coordination.description: The managed dependency, not the team, is the unit of analysis (docs/concepts/positionnement-conceptuel.md#coordination-des-dependances). The source schema forced one `mode` for the whole team; this carries one or more CoordinationMechanismBinding entries instead, each scoped to the dependency it governs.

validUntil.description: The review's validity deadline; the window between reviewedAt and validUntil may not exceed 90 days (Rego).

ThemePack.description: Naming, voice and visual presentation. Decorative and linguistic only: a theme carries no capability, policy, budget, assurance or workflow field, so renaming an agent cannot change what it may do. Open string-keyed maps in the source schema (terminology, roleOverrides, objectForms, rooms) are modeled as lists of key/value entries -- LinkML has no direct patternProperties/additionalProperties-map equivalent; the list form is exact for reading and writing, and Rego can still check "no duplicate key" as an invariant.
ThemePack.title: ThemePack

terminology.description: Display names by role key, such as chiefOfStaff or securityAgent. The technical identifier is unaffected.

ThemePresence.description: How the Chief of Staff is drawn on a surface. Every field here is presentation: there is no data source, no scope and no threshold, so the representation cannot become the thing represented.

chiefOfStaffForm.description: Named visual form. Naming one does not name an agent.

ThemePresence.title: ThemePresence

background.description: Asset reference for the room's illustrated 2D backdrop.

objectForms.description: Themed representation by business entity key -- the business term stays visible next to the metaphor (decision 216).

rooms.description: Illustrated room decor keyed by surface id (ADR-0087). A missing entry renders the classic view rather than failing.

UpstreamToolDisposition.description: EXPOSED is reachable through a declared semantic operation. WITHHELD was considered and left out. QUARANTINED was found actively unsafe.
UpstreamToolDisposition.title: UpstreamToolDisposition

UpstreamToolEntry.description: Reason required when disposition is WITHHELD or QUARANTINED (Rego): exposing a tool is justified by the operation that maps it to a capability; holding one back has no such document, so the reason lives here or nowhere.
UpstreamToolEntry.title: UpstreamToolEntry

VariableTrust.description: UNTRUSTED carries content originating outside the trust boundary -- email bodies, web pages, transcripts, inbound channel messages. This is propagated provenance metadata, not by itself a security boundary (docs/concepts/positionnement-conceptuel.md#separation-instructions-donnees): the runtime fences these and never treats them as instructions, but authorization decisions are made on concrete argument values, not on this tag alone.
VariableTrust.title: VariableTrust

VocabularyEntry.description: One CONTRACT kind's names. directory and trailer are target-state values the atomic rename (vocabulary-glossary-and-rename AC2/AC3) has not applied everywhere yet -- they are not cross-checked against the current filesystem or commit-msg hook.
VocabularyEntry.title: VocabularyEntry

VocabularySet.description: Generated concept glossary. One entry per CONTRACT kind names its canonical class, English and French display and plural forms, target instance directory and commit trailer -- the single source every directory, trailer, UI label and metamodel description name is renamed to match (canonical decision 15's sibling for vocabulary).
VocabularySet.title: VocabularySet

WireProtocol.description: The upstream request/response shape a ProviderPlatform speaks (provider-platform-catalog lot). Named after the wire shape, never a vendor account, so an aggregator can share a protocol with the platform it fronts.
WireProtocol.title: WireProtocol

WorkOrder.description: One unit of dispatched work, in Git. Renamed from WorkItem. Carries debtor, creditor, and condition (docs/concepts/positionnement-conceptuel.md#engagements-sociaux): an accepted order is not yet a social commitment without a named debtor, creditor, and discharge condition. The existing state enum (PROPOSED..FAILED) is retained as the closest Git-contract analogue of create/accept/discharge; the fuller create/discharge/release/cancel/assign operation set belongs to the runtime Matter/Episode this Git file is not -- this module models Git contracts only.
WorkOrder.title: WorkOrder

acceptanceCriteria.description: What the result is checked against. Required from ACCEPTED onward (Rego, same as the source schema's conditional).

condition.description: The condition under which this commitment is discharged, in addition to (not instead of) acceptanceCriteria -- acceptanceCriteria is what is checked; condition is the commitment-theoretic statement of when the debt is considered settled.

contractRevision.description: Commit the contracts were read at.

creditor.description: The role, team, or Project the work is owed to.

debtor.description: The role or team that owes this work (commitment lifecycle addition, conceptual upgrades table). Defaults conceptually to producerRoleDefinitionRef/teamSpecRef; kept as an explicit field so a WorkOrder assigned onward carries an accountable debtor independent of who drafted it.

decisionRefs.description: Architecture decisions this work implements or expects.

dependsOnWorkOrderRefs.description: WorkOrders that must be COMPLETED before this one starts.

ledgerSourceRevision.description: Commit that carried the last full (pre-compaction) revision of this record, for a COMPLETED WorkOrder compacted into .jumo/work/ledger/. Set by the closure tooling that writes the record, never by hand.

pathScope.description: Glob patterns the work may touch.

producerRoleDefinitionRef.description: The individual accountable role. A team is never the final accountable addressee.

ring.description: The ring this work acts on. RING_0_ROOT_OF_TRUST exclusion (source schema's `not: const`) moves to Rego.

roadmapRef.description: Groups durable work contracts into a generated roadmap projection.

secretBindingRefs.description: SecretBindings this WorkOrder is authorized to request a delegated lease grant for. Empty by default. Reciprocity with SecretBindingSpec.allowedWorkOrderRefs is required by policy (openbao-delegated-lease AC2).

specification.description: Long-form design lots too large for purpose/condition/acceptanceCriteria -- Markdown body, no language restriction (WorkOrder specification prose is exempt from the English-only rule, AGENTS.md).

suspendedReason.description: Set when state is PROPOSED after having been ACCEPTED or IN_PROGRESS, to record why work paused rather than why it was declined. Distinct from declineReason, which is permanent.

verifierRoleDefinitionRef.description: The role that checks the result against the criteria below. May not be the producer; resolves through teamSpecRef to prove a different independence group (Rego).

WorkOrderState.description: PROPOSED and ACCEPTED are separate because a work order is not an acceptance, in the same way a CapturedInput is not a Commitment.
WorkOrderState.title: WorkOrderState

WorkerCli.description: The CLI a worker substrate runs. Shared vocabulary -- a WorkerSubstrate declares which one it runs (integration) and a CliToolDefinition declares which one it implements (execution), so neither module has to import the other and no naming convention links a tool to a value.
WorkerCli.title: WorkerCli

digest.description: A tag is a moving target; evidence names the bytes that ran.

WorkerInvocation.description: Ephemeral recognized binding of a turn, route, cell, grant and execution evidence.
WorkerInvocation.title: WorkerInvocation

containerRuntimeSocket.description: A runtime socket mount hands the container authority over its own sandbox.

network.description: Open egress is absent because it would let a CLI re-acquire authority outside Jumo's grant.

credentialSource.description: MODEL_WORKER_PROCESS may consume only an OpenBao-rendered file bound to this substrate; no environment value, repository mount, or ambient credential is permitted.

WorkerRequirementProfile.description: A multi-dimensional task requirement vector used to select an eligible runtime Worker. Names neither provider nor model and defines no aggregate power score.
WorkerRequirementProfile.title: WorkerRequirementProfile

onInsufficiency.description: How this profile responds to its own worker's INSUFFICIENT_NEEDS_DEPTH signal (ADR-0019, worker-sufficiency-bounded-escalation). Absent defaults to NONE -- most profiles take the existing human-decision path rather than an automatic bounded retry.

requiredIndependenceGroup.description: Narrows eligible ProviderAccounts to those sharing this independenceGroup (own, or inherited from their ProviderPlatform). Two profiles at the same reasoningEffort rung are otherwise indistinguishable for routing purposes (provider-platform-catalog lot); a producing and a verifying role's profiles declare disjoint values here when ADR-0019's independence separation must hold operationally, not just architecturally. Absent by default -- most profiles route on rung alone.

WorkerSubstrate.description: Realm-owned declaration of a constrained worker runtime. A Git-reviewed security boundary: native CLI homes, repository mounts, database reach, open egress, container runtime sockets and built-in connector authority are absent so Jumo policy remains the only authority path.
WorkerSubstrate.title: WorkerSubstrate

accountUse.description: Which ProviderAccount use context this substrate is authorized to consume, explicit so a declared substrate never silently upgrades from holder-operated to Jumo-managed use.

ambientToolAuthority.description: No CLI home, image, plugin, repository file, or provider default silently grants tool access.

executionMachineRef.description: Durable execution machine selected for this CLI substrate; an ExecutionCellLease remains invocation-scoped.

grantedOperationRefs.description: The only external reach available to the substrate.

homeState.description: A mounted CLI home carries native connectors, consent history and trusted folders; isolated per-invocation state removes that duplicated authority.

nativeToolAuthority.description: CLI-native connectors and MCP servers are disabled so the fact is reviewable rather than hidden in an image. Unaffected by AGENTS.md's development-agent MCP directives -- those govern a human's own terminal session, not a dispatched worker.

projectedToolAuthority.description: Tool capabilities are dynamically projected by the Jumo capability gateway via an invocation-scoped Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint based on explicit InvocationCapabilityGrants.

usageContext.description: Licensing and entitlement fact only. Not a security boundary and not a sphere.

WorkloadCommand.description: Typed workload command claimed by pull from an ExecutionMachine, distinct from the Ansible-only MachineAdminCommand. Bound to the ExecutionCellLease that scopes its workload boundary (ADR-0047).
WorkloadCommand.title: WorkloadCommand

WorkloadCommandResult.description: Terminal outcome of a claimed WorkloadCommand, sanitized before it leaves the machine.
WorkloadCommandResult.title: WorkloadCommandResult

WorkloadDriverKind.description: Closed over the drivers activatable by machine-pull-workload-supervisor. The SPI stays platform-neutral for a later home-automation or mobile driver -- a new value is appended when that driver actually exists, not reserved speculatively here.
WorkloadDriverKind.title: WorkloadDriverKind

title: jumo_v1
